candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to the caller, changing behavior when withdraw is overridden/guarded.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, changing who can trigger balance withdrawal.
Call withdraw with a fixed constant (0) instead of the contract balance, preventing funds from being withdrawn.
Call withdraw with a smaller fixed amount (1 wei) instead of the full balance, changing amount withdrawn.
Invert the onlyOwner require so that only non-owners may call guarded functions, changing access to withdrawAll.
Replace transfer to send with a low-level call that does not revert on failure, so withdraw may not actually transfer funds while still returning (no require on success).
Replace transfer with a require that the contract has at least _value, preventing transfer of excessive amounts (changes behavior when balance < _value).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone to call protected functions by commenting out the require, changing who can call withdraw.
Change the call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure and does not forward all gas, altering whether sendMoney succeeds and thus the contract balance after the call.
Remove the require on the low-level call result so failures in the call do not revert, allowing sendMoney to return without transferring value and leaving contract balance unchanged on call failure.

Swap the call target and sender by attempting to call this contract (address(this)) instead of the provided _target, changing which external address receives the value and thus the contract balance after the call.
Relax the onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller, which changes who can invoke sendMoney and thus who can change the contract balance via that function.
